about.privacy: Watch data stays on this phone in joyofit.db until you sign in to the cloud. With Pro, cycle data (switchable), settings, sticker templates and saved routes also follow your account in the cloud. Signing out never deletes data on the phone unless you choose it. Weather, if switched on, sends rounded coordinates to Open-Meteo. Privacy policy: fit.joyorogo.com/privasi

advanced.repairSubtitle: Checks the data file on this phone and repairs it if it is damaged
advanced.repairHealthy: No damage found in the data file. If an error keeps coming back, close the app completely and open it again.
advanced.bleDenied: Nearby devices permission denied: the watch is tried at its paired address without a scan.
advanced.coursesSubtitle: Build a course and send it to the watch
advanced.agnssLabRisk: Off by default. When on and the watch asks for the HW_AGNSS kind, JoyoFit sends satellite data that JoyoFit's server builds from public broadcast data (IGS/BKG), not from Huawei. The phone fetches it from JoyoFit's server with no personal data; the server sees the IP address. The watch does not check this data, and wrong data has wedged the GPS of other watches. A factory reset recovers the watch. Unproven on any watch: turn it on only to test.
advanced.pgnssLab: JoyoFit HW_PGNSS_PRED predicted satellite data (lab test)
advanced.pgnssLabRisk: Off by default, separate from the switch above. When on and the watch asks for the HW_PGNSS_PRED kind, JoyoFit sends six files of predicted satellite orbits for the next 3 days that JoyoFit's server computes from public data, laid out like Huawei's own files but not from Huawei. The phone fetches them (about 800 KB) from JoyoFit's server with no personal data; the server sees the IP address. Riskier than HW_AGNSS: the predictions are unverified, the watch keeps them for days and does not check them, and wrong data has wedged the GPS of other watches. A factory reset recovers the watch. Unproven on any watch: turn it on only to test.
advanced.details: Running courses: unverified, the course format comes from static analysis of Huawei Health. The watch may refuse it.
advanced.detailsDev: Running courses: unverified, the course format comes from static analysis of Huawei Health. The watch may refuse it. Bluetooth LE link: connect over Bluetooth LE GATT (service FE86) instead of the watch's own link. Disconnect and connect again to apply. Steps go to logcat tag JoyoFitBle.
advanced.offlineMapLab: Offline maps on the watch (lab test)
advanced.offlineMapLabSubtitle: Download maps built from OpenStreetMap and send them to the watch
advanced.offlineMapLabRisk: Off by default. When on, JoyoFit talks to the watch's offline-map app (the way the watch maker's app sends its maps). The lab screen downloads map files that JoyoFit builds from OpenStreetMap from JoyoFit's server (api.fit.joyorogo.com; the request carries no location, ID or account, the server sees your IP address) and sends them to the watch. The map format comes from public research, not from the watch maker; the watch may refuse a file or its map app may misbehave. Delete the map from the lab screen to undo. Unproven on any watch: turn it on only to test.

cloud.title: Cloud sync
cloud.notConfigured: No cloud server URL in this build. Deploy server/, set EXPO_PUBLIC_JOYOFIT_CLOUD_URL, rebuild.
cloud.refused_one: {{n}} workout could not be uploaded. It is tried again tomorrow, or sooner after an app update.
cloud.refused_other: {{n}} workouts could not be uploaded. They are tried again tomorrow, or sooner after an app update.
cloud.wifiOnlyHint: Automatic sync waits for Wi-Fi or Ethernet, so workouts do not use mobile data.
cloud.autoSyncHint: Sync after each watch sync and when you open the app.
cloud.deleteWarning: Deletes your JoyoRogo account (the one JoyoRogo uses) and everything it holds in the cloud: your JoyoRogo diary, groups and photos, and the data JoyoFit backed up. Cannot be undone; you are signed out of both apps. Data on this phone stays.
cloud.deleteApple: Apple will ask you to confirm first.
cloud.mobileMessage: Wi-Fi only is on and this phone is not on Wi-Fi. Syncing now can use a lot of mobile data when workouts are waiting.
cloud.wipeMessage: Removes your workouts, steps and sleep from the cloud. This phone's data and your account stay, and automatic sync is turned off so nothing is uploaded again until you turn it back on.
cloud.details: Cloud sync is part of JoyoRogo Pro. With a Pro account every workout is uploaded to your JoyoRogo account as one compressed file: its GPS track, heart rate, speed, cadence and power, and the analysis the app shows, so it survives a lost phone, shows on the JoyoRogo web and restores onto a new phone after you sign in. Steps, heart rate, SpO2, sleep and the watch's Bluetooth address go to the JoyoFit cloud with the same account. Without Pro nothing is uploaded and your workouts stay on this phone. While you are signed in the app also reads from the cloud: it downloads workouts this phone does not have, and removes the ones you deleted from the cloud elsewhere. JoyoFit also exchanges meals, weight and daily scores with JoyoRogo. With Pro, the settings that follow the account (profile, goals, theme, language, weather, cycle calendar), sticker templates, saved routes, HRV, sleep scores, health metrics and cycle data follow your account too, so several phones show the same thing; cycle data can be switched off with the Sync cycle data switch, which deletes its copy in the cloud. Watch pairing, the watch key and each phone's own settings do not sync. Delete cloud data removes your workouts, steps, sleep and the data that follows the account from the cloud and keeps this phone's data and your account; Delete JoyoRogo account removes the account and everything else (details at fit.joyorogo.com/privasi).
cloud.onlyHere: This data is only on this phone. Pro keeps it in the cloud.
cloud.proSyncs: Syncs: workouts, steps, sleep, gear, the coach plan, strength history, settings, sticker templates, routes and health data. Does not sync: watch pairing, the Health Connect or Apple Health connection, and each phone's own settings (Wi-Fi only, automatic sync, permissions).
cloud.pairingNote: Your history shows here, but the watch has to be paired on this phone. Watch pairing does not go to the cloud.
cloud.restoringProgress: Restoring data from the cloud... {{done}} of {{total}}
cloud.cycleSyncHint: Cycle data is health data and only syncs for Pro. Turning it off deletes the copy in the cloud.
cloud.firstSignInHint: The data already on this phone goes to the first account you sign in to.
cloud.signInAgainHint: The data on this phone belongs to {{email}}. If you sign in with another account, you are asked what to do with it first.
cloud.recordsFull: Your cloud storage is full (50 MB for settings, routes, templates and health data). Some new changes stay on this phone; delete routes or templates you do not use and sync again.

goals.saved: Saved. It is sent the next time the watch connects.
goals.title: Activity goals
goals.details: The three rings and the calorie goal on the watch. The steps goal is also your daily step goal in Profile and goal. Sent on save and whenever the watch connects. Stand reminder: the watch nudges you when you have been sitting. Progress reminder: tells you how far along the day's goals are. Goal reached: celebrates when a ring closes.

forecast.unsupported: This watch takes current weather only: it does not list the forecast command.
forecast.unacknowledged: The watch did not confirm the forecast. Current weather was sent.

background.btRequired: Bluetooth permission is required to stay connected in the background.
background.title: Background

background.details: Keeps the link to the watch up while the app is closed.

appleImport.title: Import history from Apple Health
appleImport.intro: Huawei Health on iPhone saves your steps, heart rate, sleep, blood oxygen and workouts in Apple Health. Bring that history into JoyoFit once. JoyoFit asks for permission to read Apple Health when you tap the button below, reads it on this phone and sends nothing anywhere.
appleImport.footer: Data your watch already stored in JoyoFit is never replaced, and importing again adds nothing new. Data JoyoFit itself saved to Apple Health is skipped. Imported days stay on this phone: they are not uploaded to the cloud, written back to Apple Health or sent to Strava.
appleImport.stoppedNotice: You stopped the import. What was read so far is saved; import again to continue.
appleImport.nothing: Nothing was found. Check that JoyoFit may read Apple Health (Health, your profile picture, Apps, JoyoFit) and that Huawei Health saves to Apple Health.

stress.unavailable: Not available on this watch: it does not list automatic stress, so it records no night HRV.
stress.label: Automatic stress
stress.calibrating: Calibrating: sit still, {{seconds}} s left, {{beats}} beats so far.
stress.calibratingStart: Calibrating: sit still with the watch snug. This takes a minute.

fitImport.title: Import a FIT file
fitImport.intro: A ride or run from a bike computer or sports watch, with route, heart rate, speed, power and cadence. Free, runs on this phone.
fitImport.shareIos: In Files or the app that has the file, choose Share, then JoyoFit.
fitImport.shareAndroid: In your file manager or the bike computer app, open the .fit file with JoyoFit, or share it to JoyoFit.
fitImport.details: Works with the .fit files of iGPSPORT, Garmin, Wahoo, Bryton, Magene and XOSS. {{share}} Importing the same file twice adds nothing, and a file that overlaps a workout your watch already recorded is skipped: the workout from the watch is kept. Imported workouts count for strain, readiness and trends, stay on this phone and are not uploaded to the cloud, written to {{app}} or sent to Strava on their own.

healthConnect.noWrite: No write permission was granted. Allow JoyoFit in {{store}} to turn this on.
healthConnect.details: Sends steps, distance, calories, heart rate, blood oxygen, sleep and workouts (on Android with their GPS route) after every sync, so other apps such as JoyoRogo can read them. Turning it on also writes what is already stored.

healthyLiving.notAsked: The watch has not asked for tasks yet. Open Healthy Living on the watch once.
healthyLiving.title: Healthy Living
healthyLiving.sent: Sent. Open Healthy Living on the watch to check.
healthyLiving.details: On by default. Switching on takes effect on the next connect, switching off at once. The watch asks for its tasks itself; the button sends today's tasks without waiting for a request. Unverified on the watch: based on Huawei Health's protocol.

heartRate.unsupported: This watch does not offer it.
heartRate.title: Heart rate and sensors
heartRate.notConnected: Not connected: changes are saved and sent on the next connect.
heartRate.notConfirmed: The watch did not confirm every change. See the Log.

details.continuous: Continuous heart rate: the watch records your heart rate about every minute. Without it Today shows no heart rate.
details.spo2: Automatic SpO2: measures blood oxygen in the background.
details.sleep: Sleep tracking (TruSleep): newer watches record the sleep stages with it on. Some older watches only report when you slept, shown as "Sleep (no stages)", and may give light and deep sleep with it off.
details.stress: Automatic stress: turning it on takes 1 minute of sitting still with the watch snug. The phone measures your beat intervals and sends the watch a baseline.
details.high: High alert: the watch warns when your heart rate stays above this. Needs continuous heart rate.
details.low: Low alert: the watch warns when your heart rate stays below this.

history.title: Watch history
history.detailsIos: Pulls every day of steps, heart rate, sleep and workouts the watch still holds, not only what is new since the last sync. It can take a few minutes. Data already on the phone is kept.
history.details: Pulls every day of steps, heart rate, sleep, HRV and workouts the watch still holds, not only what is new since the last sync. It can take a few minutes. Data already on the phone is kept.

huaweiImport.requestIntro: Heart rate, sleep, steps, workouts and weight from your Huawei Health account. Free, runs on this phone, sends nothing.

steps.1: Tap the button below and sign in with your Huawei ID.
steps.2: Choose Request your data and tick Health data.
steps.3: Set a password for the ZIP and remember it: Huawei cannot show it again and the file does not open without it.
steps.4: Wait for the email from Huawei. This can take up to 7 days, and the link works for 21 days. Large exports come as several ZIP parts of up to 5 GB each.
steps.5: Before you unbind the watch from Huawei Health, open Huawei Health and pull down to sync once more. What is only on the watch and not yet in your account is lost when you unbind it.
steps.6Ios: Download the ZIP (on iPhone it ends up in the Files app), then choose it below and enter the password.
steps.6Android: Download the ZIP, then tap it in your email or Files app and choose JoyoFit, or choose it below. Enter the password.

huaweiImport.details: The password is the one you set when you requested the data; it is only kept while this screen is open. Data the watch already stored on this phone is never replaced. Importing the same file twice adds nothing the second time. Imported days stay on this phone: they are not uploaded to the cloud, written to {{app}} or sent to Strava.
huaweiImport.stoppedNotice: You stopped the import. What was read so far is saved; import the same file again to continue.
huaweiImport.profileFilled: Your profile was empty, so it now has the {{height}} cm from the export (with its weight, birth year and sex). Check it in Profile.
huaweiImport.rogoNothingNew: JoyoRogo already had all of it, or none of it fits a past day.
huaweiImport.rogoError: JoyoRogo answered: {{message}}. It stays waiting; try again after updating the app.
huaweiImport.rogoWaiting_one: One item is waiting to be sent. Sign in to JoyoRogo and check the connection.
huaweiImport.rogoWaiting_other: {{count}} items are waiting to be sent. Sign in to JoyoRogo and check the connection.
huaweiImport.rogoDetails: Weigh-ins, meals and water from the export are added to your JoyoRogo history on their real days, only for days before today. A day you already weighed or counted water, or a meal you already logged with the same kcal, is left as it is, so sending again adds nothing. Imported meals and weigh-ins do not count toward streaks or challenges, and an old weight never replaces your newest one.
huaweiImport.workoutsUpdated: Workouts completed with route and totals
huaweiImport.keepOpen: Keep JoyoFit open until it finishes (a large file can take several minutes). The screen may dim; do not switch to another app.
huaweiImport.leftOutTitle: In the file but not stored by JoyoFit
huaweiImport.filesFailed_one: One file in the ZIP could not be read. The rest was imported; download the export again to fill the gap.
huaweiImport.filesFailed_other: {{count}} files in the ZIP could not be read. The rest was imported; download the export again to fill the gap.
huaweiImport.summaryDetails: Weight and body composition go to your scale history, marked as not sent to JoyoRogo. Days that have only a daily total (no per-minute data in the export) show their steps at 12:00.

errors.password: That password did not open the ZIP. Use the one you set when you requested your data from Huawei.
errors.format: This file is not a Huawei Health export. Pick the ZIP from the Huawei email, the one with your Health data.

notifApps.iosDesc: JoyoFit does not forward notifications on iOS. The watch reads them from the iPhone, and which apps appear is set in iPhone Settings, Notifications.
notifApps.hint: Apps you haven't chosen are on, except system apps.

ios.intro: The watch filters the iPhone's notifications itself, per app. The list is fixed: the common apps and one Other switch for every other app. iPhone Settings, Notifications, still decides what reaches the watch at all.
ios.unproven: The per-app switches are not proven to work on this watch, so they stay off. The filter test turns one app off on the watch in a few ways of writing it. You check whether its message still shows up, and the way that works is used for all the switches.

block.noGate: This watch does not list per-app switches, so it cannot be tested.

ios.probe: Step {{step}} of {{steps}}. {{app}} is being turned off on the watch. Send one message to {{app}} now from another phone or person, not from this iPhone, and keep JoyoFit open: switching apps or screens cancels the test. Does the message still show up on the watch?
ios.confirm: {{app}} is turned back on on the watch. Send one more message. Does it show up now?

outcome.winner: It worked: the watch filters in the way "{{how}}". Every app was turned back on and the switches below are now active.
outcome.none: No way hid {{app}} on the watch. This watch may not filter by iOS app id. The switches stay off.
outcome.inconclusive: {{app}} did not show up, but did not come back after being turned on again, so it may not have been the filter. Nothing was saved. Try again.
outcome.cancelled: The test was cancelled and {{app}} was turned back on on the watch.
outcome.failed: The test failed: the watch did not take the command or the connection dropped. {{app}} is turned back on as soon as the watch connects.

ios.restorePending: A test was cut off. The app that was tested is turned back on as soon as the watch connects. If its notifications are still missing, run the test again.
ios.sendResult: Send the result to the team

rowHint.noId: No id for this app in the proven way
rowHint.other: Every other app. Not tested, it may have no effect.
rowHint.offline: Sent to the watch when it connects

ios.details: These switches work on the watch, not on the iPhone: JoyoFit never sees your notifications. The test sends one app only, never the whole list, and that app is turned back on afterwards, when the test is cancelled, or when the watch connects again. The test result holds the ways tried and your answers, no message content.

notifications.disclosure: JoyoFit reads the notifications on this phone (app name, title and text) so it can show them on your watch. They are sent to the watch over Bluetooth only. JoyoFit does not store them and does not send them over the internet. You can choose which apps are forwarded, and turn this off at any time.
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.restricted: Android 13+: first allow restricted settings (App info, menu, Allow restricted settings).
notifications.morningDenied: Notification permission denied: the summary cannot be shown.
notifications.details:
Forwarding sends the app name, title and text of each notification to the watch over Bluetooth only. Nothing is stored or sent over the internet. Choose which apps are forwarded in Notification apps.

Morning summary: once a day after the sync that brings in last night's sleep, with time asleep and HRV against your usual.

ios.howTo: iPhone Settings, Bluetooth, tap i next to the watch, turn on Show Notifications. Allow it if iOS asks.
ios.details:
iOS does not let JoyoFit read or forward your notifications. The watch reads them from the iPhone itself, over Bluetooth, when iOS allows it; JoyoFit never sees their content. Which apps appear is chosen in iPhone Settings, Notifications.

The switch changes the watch's own notification setting, the one Huawei Health sets. It is left alone until you change it here.

The morning summary notification is not available on iOS yet.

phone.title: Phone and calls
phone.iosFind: Find my phone from the watch: not possible on iOS.
phone.iosCalls: Answering or rejecting calls from the watch: not possible on iOS.
phone.iosDetails:
Find my phone: iOS suspends JoyoFit when it is not on screen and does not let it ring the phone on request, so the watch button cannot find this iPhone. Use Find My on another Apple device or iCloud.com instead.

Calls: iOS does not let an app see, answer or reject phone calls. If the watch shows incoming calls at all, it does so itself through the notifications iOS shares with it (Notifications settings).
phone.errPhoneState: Phone state permission is required to see incoming calls.
phone.errAnswer: Permission to answer phone calls is required.
phone.findPhone: Find my phone from the watch
phone.showCalls: Show incoming calls on the watch
phone.callControl: Answer and reject calls from the watch
phone.callerIdDetails: Without call log access Android hides the caller number. Without contacts access you see the number instead of the name.
phone.noCallerIdDetails: The watch shows that the phone is ringing. This version of JoyoFit does not read your call log or contacts, so it cannot show who is calling.
phone.findDetails: Find my phone: the watch button rings this phone loudly, even with the app closed. Stop it on the watch or from the notification.

errors.height: Height must be a whole number from 100 to 250 cm.
errors.weight: Weight must be from 20 to 300 kg.
errors.birthYear: Birth year must be a whole number from 1900 to {{year}}.
errors.steps: Daily step goal must be a whole number from 1000 to 100000.

profile.saved: Saved. It is sent the next time the watch connects.
profile.title: Profile and goal
profile.details: The watch uses these for calories and its step goal. Nothing is sent until you save.

appearance.title: Theme
appearance.details: A theme changes colors, corner shapes, fonts and the size of the big numbers. Themes marked as following the phone use its light or dark setting; the others are fixed. Applying a theme restarts the app so every screen and the bars start clean in it; if it does not restart by itself, close the app and open it again.

confirm.title: Apply the {{name}} theme?
confirm.message: The app will restart so colors, fonts and the navigation bars start clean in the new theme.

meals.title: Meals on watch
meals.unsynced_one: {{count}} meal logged on the watch will be written to JoyoRogo the next time the app reads it.
meals.unsynced_other: {{count}} meals logged on the watch will be written to JoyoRogo the next time the app reads it.
meals.details: Your JoyoRogo food diary and calorie target feed the calorie card on the watch. JoyoFit reads them when it opens, after each sync and when the watch connects, and sends them again when the watch asks or logs a meal itself. While the app is closed the background service answers from the last day it stored; it cannot read JoyoRogo then, because the sign-in is kept for the app only. Untested on the Fit 4 Pro so far. While signed in, the app also sends your daily Recovery, Strain and Sleep to the JoyoRogo diary so they sit next to your food, plus today's body metrics once computed (hours slept, resting heart rate, HRV, VO2max, training status, recovery time). Whatever cannot be computed yet is not sent.

sms.title: Send SMS for SOS
sms.message: When your watch sends an SOS, JoyoFit sends the text message it asks for, from this phone and your SIM. It never sends anything else.
sms.denied: Without the SMS permission JoyoFit cannot send the SOS text. The relay stays off.

safety.testReady: Ready: an SOS from the watch would be sent as a text. Nothing was sent now.
safety.testBlocked: An SOS from the watch would not be sent: {{blockers}}. Nothing was sent now.
safety.fallDetailsSms: After a hard fall the watch asks you if you are all right and can start an SOS.
safety.fallDetails: After a hard fall the watch asks you if you are all right. This version of JoyoFit cannot send the SOS text.
safety.sosSwitch: Send SOS texts for the watch
safety.sosDetails: When you start an SOS on the watch, the watch hands this phone a number and a message. With the switch on, JoyoFit sends that text from your SIM and tells the watch whether it went out. The watch (or its emergency contacts in the Huawei settings on it) decides who is texted; JoyoFit never picks a recipient and never sends anything the watch did not ask for. Off by default. Needs permission to send SMS and a ready SIM; costs whatever your plan charges per text. If an SOS would not be sent, the watch is told it failed.
safety.iosNotice: Not possible on iOS. Do not rely on the watch to text your contacts.
safety.iosDetails: iOS does not let an app send a text message by itself, so JoyoFit cannot text your contacts when the watch starts an SOS. JoyoFit tells the watch that nothing was sent.
safety.playNotice: Not in the Google Play version. Do not rely on the watch to text your contacts.
safety.playDetails: Google Play restricts apps that send text messages, so this version does not include the feature. An SOS started on the watch is not sent as an SMS from this phone: JoyoFit tells the watch that nothing was sent.
safety.sleepUnavailable: Not available: the watch does not report the event channel it needs.
safety.sleepDetails: Once each morning, after the first sync that holds last night, the watch shows how long you slept and the stages.

strava.intro: Send watch workouts to Strava. Free while slots are spare; uploading by hand always works.
strava.how: Workouts go to Strava with the distance, calories, heart rate and route the watch recorded. After you connect, workouts that finish from then on are sent after each sync; earlier ones stay on the phone unless you send them from the workout screen. JoyoFit only sends workouts to your own Strava account and never reads your Strava activities.
strava.noCloud: No cloud server URL in this build, which Strava needs. Deploy server/, set EXPO_PUBLIC_JOYOFIT_CLOUD_URL, rebuild.
strava.serverNotReady: Strava is not set up on the JoyoFit server yet.
strava.signInFirst: Sign in with JoyoRogo first; it only keeps your Strava connection on the server.

slots.full: All slots are in use right now. Try again later; uploading by hand with 'Upload to Strava (manual)' on the workout page always works.
slots.releasedTitle: Strava connection released because it had not been used for a while
slots.released: Released on {{date}}. Send workouts with 'Upload to Strava (manual)' on the workout page, or connect again when a slot is open.

strava.addLinkHint: Plain text, never in the title.
strava.addDevice: Name the watch in the description
strava.addDeviceHint: For example: Recorded with HUAWEI WATCH FIT 4 Pro. Added below your description, never in the title.
strava.signInToDisconnect: Sign in with JoyoRogo to disconnect or send.
strava.legal: Compatible with Strava. JoyoFit is not made, sponsored or endorsed by Strava. What you send follows your Strava privacy settings; you can remove JoyoFit any time in Strava under Settings, My Apps.

joyorogo.title: Exercise energy to JoyoRogo
joyorogo.intro: The energy of workouts from the watch, phone recordings and strength training goes to JoyoRogo's diary as burned calories. A workout JoyoRogo also reads from Health Connect or Apple Health is not counted twice.
joyorogo.signedOut: Sign in with your JoyoRogo account (More, account) so your exercise energy reaches JoyoRogo.
joyorogo.waitingHint: Sent at the next sync. The last 30 days of workouts go; those JoyoRogo already has are not duplicated.
joyorogo.autoSyncOff: Automatic sync is off. Tap Send now to send.

sleep.title: Sleep insights
sleep.label: Send sleep data to JoyoRogo (Sleep insights)
sleep.hint: JoyoRogo looks for patterns in your sleep, like caffeine or a dinner that ran late. You see the results in JoyoRogo, Sleep tab.
sleep.viewIn: Your sleep findings and patterns are in JoyoRogo, Sleep tab.

state.unsupported: Your JoyoRogo does not have Sleep insights yet. Try again once JoyoRogo is updated.
state.offline: Cannot reach JoyoRogo right now, so this setting cannot be read or changed. Try again later.
state.nights_one: JoyoRogo holds {{n}} night of your sleep.
state.nights_other: JoyoRogo holds {{n}} nights of your sleep.

consent.title: Send sleep data to JoyoRogo?
consent.body:
Sent each night: when you fell asleep and woke up, time asleep and awake, how many times you woke, sleep stages (only if your watch produces them), the watch's sleep score, last night's HRV and resting heart rate when available, and naps.

Not sent: per-minute data, all-day heart rate, location, and workouts.

JoyoRogo keeps the last 90 nights and uses them to build your sleep insights. This data is not shared and not used for ads. You can turn it off any time, here or in JoyoRogo; when you turn it off, all sleep data on the JoyoRogo server is deleted.

disable.title: Turn off Sleep insights?
disable.body: All your sleep data on JoyoRogo is deleted, including insights already made. Data on your phone does not change.

weather.deniedAndroid: Location denied: weather for this phone cannot be fetched. Allow it, or choose a city.
weather.deniedIos: Location is off for JoyoFit. Turn it on in Settings > JoyoFit > Location (While Using the App), or choose a city.
weather.title: Weather
weather.connect: Connect the watch to send weather.
weather.noService: This watch does not list the weather service.
weather.details: Sends current weather and a forecast, on every connect and at the chosen interval. Data comes from Open-Meteo; only coordinates rounded to about 1 km go out.
weather.detailsIos: This phone: uses your approximate location while the app is open. When the watch asks in the background, iOS gives the app no fresh position, so the last one is reused.
weather.detailsAndroid: This phone: uses the last known coarse location. In the background Android may not give a fresh one, so the last position is reused.

quickReplies.title: Quick replies
quickReplies.rowSubtitle: Short answers the watch offers when you reply to a notification
quickReplies.intro: You pick one on the watch when you answer a message from WhatsApp, Telegram and other apps. The order here is the order on the watch.
quickReplies.stored: Saved. It goes to the watch when it connects.
quickReplies.needsWatch: The connected watch does not support quick replies.

method.title: How zones are calculated
method.maxBody: Zones 1 to 5 start at 50, 60, 70, 80 and 90 percent of your maximum heart rate. This is Huawei Health's default.
method.hrrBody: Warm-up starts at 50 percent of your heart rate reserve (max HR minus resting HR), then zones 2 to 6 start at 59, 74, 84, 88 and 95 percent, all added to your resting HR. The zone order and names match the watch and Huawei Health. A better fit when your resting HR is low.
method.lthrBody: Friel zones from your lactate threshold heart rate (LTHR): zone 1 starts at 67 percent of LTHR, zone 2 at 85, zone 3 at 90, zone 4 at 95 and zone 5 at 100 percent. Works best when your LTHR comes from a test, not an estimate.

rates.noProfile: No age in your profile yet, so {{age}} years is used.
rates.details: Max HR runs from 100 to {{max}} bpm. Resting HR runs from {{restMin}} to {{restMax}} bpm and sits at least {{gap}} bpm under max HR, as in Huawei Health. Tanaka uses 208 - 0.7 x age; 220 - age is a rough rule, especially for older or well-trained people.

zones.title: Zones
zones.custom: You changed the zone limits by hand.
zones.scope: Applies to past workouts too (time per zone, Coach). Strain and intensity minutes always use % of max HR.
zones.details: The bpm and percent boxes are where each zone starts: tap a box and type to change it. Changing the method, max HR or resting HR works them out again. Time per zone in workouts, the daily heart-rate chart, Coach and the watch's workout screen use these limits. Strain, training load and intensity minutes always use fixed percentages of max HR (Edwards: 50, 60, 70, 80, 90), so changing the zones never changes them. Workouts already uploaded to JoyoRogo keep the zone time they were uploaded with.

alert.title: Heart-rate limit alert
alert.hint: The watch alerts you when HR goes over the limit.

suggest.title: Work out from data
suggest.body: Only a suggestion: nothing changes until you use it and save.
suggest.nothing: No workout with heart rate yet, and no resting HR from the watch yet.
suggest.peakAbove: Above the age estimate ({{bpm}} bpm), so the age formula may be too low for you.
suggest.peakBelow: Still under the age estimate ({{bpm}} bpm). That is not necessarily your limit, so it is not suggested.
suggest.rest: Resting HR from the watch: {{bpm}} bpm
suggest.restBody: The median of the last 14 days. Used by the HRR method.
suggest.lthrRun: LTHR from your hardest run: {{bpm}} bpm
suggest.lthrRunBody: 95% of your hardest 20-minute average heart rate, run on {{date}}. Use = the LTHR method with this number.
suggest.lthrRunNone: LTHR from runs: no run in the last 6 weeks had 20 minutes hard enough (at least 80% of max HR).
suggest.failed: The data could not be read. Try again.

watch.none: This watch does not take zones from the app. They are used in JoyoFit's analysis only.

saved.sent: Saved and sent to the watch.

saved.none: Saved. This watch does not take zones from the app.

lthr.label: Lactate threshold heart rate
lthr.estimate: Huawei Health estimate (85 percent of the reserve)
lthr.runTest: Measure it with the lactate threshold test
lthr.fromRunNote: Estimate: 95% of your hardest 20-minute average heart rate, run on {{date}}. The 30-minute test is still the most accurate.
lthr.details: These zones use Joe Friel's percentages of LTHR. The watch takes them as ordinary heart-rate zones (five bpm limits).
